methodologyNotes: The roster covers 12 high-search full-body massage chairs spanning budget through luxury tiers (2019-2024 models). Specs were re-verified against manufacturer product pages (Osaki/Titan via osakimassagechair.com, Human Touch, Daiwa, Ogawa World USA, Luraco, Kahuna) and authorized multi-brand retailers (MassageChairs.com, The Back Store, The Modern Back, massage-chair-relief.com, Home Depot, Newegg, Tittac). roller_type reflects the manufacturer's primary roller hardware designation (2D/3D/4D) — note that some chairs market '4D programs' on a 3D roller mechanism; we record the roller hardware. track_type uses the manufacturer's primary label (s_track, l_track, sl_track, split_l_track). program_count is the stated number of automatic/pre-set programs. max_user_height_in is the published maximum recommended user height in whole inches. Boolean specs are true only when confirmed by a manufacturer or authorized retailer source. Adversarial pass corrected the Osaki Maestro program count (15->8), Human Touch roller hardware (4D->3D), Brookstone BK-150 price (3999->3199), and replaced two unreachable/wrong source URLs. accessedAt 2026-06-19.

products.name: Osaki OS-Pro Maestro LE 2.0
products.priceNote: List price 'as low as $11,999' per The Back Store; the closely related 'Osaki 4D Maestro LE 2.0' SKU lists at $13,999/sale $7,999 on osakimassagechair.com
products.provenance: List price $11,999 confirmed on The Back Store product page (page loads). 4D roller + SL-track confirmed. CORRECTION: program_count changed 15->8 — both The Back Store and the official Osaki page state '8 Auto Programs & 6 Massage Styles'; the draft's 15 was unsupported. Max user height 6'3" (75 in) confirmed by retailer specs. Release 2023 (LE 2.0 generation). Heat (heated back roller) and computerized body scan confirmed.
